title: Check Anagram
statement:
Two strings are anagrams if one can be rearranged to form the other — they must contain the exact same characters with the same frequencies.

Given two strings A and B of lowercase English letters, print "Yes" if they are anagrams, otherwise print "No".
constraints:
1 <= |A|, |B| <= 10^5
A and B contain only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: Two lines: the first contains A, the second contains B.
outputFormat: Print "Yes" if A and B are anagrams, otherwise "No".

examples.explanation: Both strings contain the same characters with the same frequencies.
